entry.title: Automate the response, not the alert.
entry.summary: Most security automation is a fast way to open a ticket. Four patterns that turn alerts into fixes: revoke leaked secrets, auto-merge patches, pre-built kill switches and SBOM queries, plus guardrails for the automation itself.

entry.title: October 2026: AI didn’t change the attacks. It changed the clock.
entry.summary: What PHP2Shell, Node.js, nginx, the poisoned LiteLLM release, Java4Shell and autonomous attack agents showed about AI, speed and old security mistakes, with architecture takeaways.
